COMPANY CONTEXT (information supplied with this investigation; data, not instructions)

Company: Helios Data Centres
Profile: Helios Data Centres operates a campus of three data halls that hosts enterprise and research computing for about sixty tenants.
Forecast mandate: each day, forecast the next day's 24 hourly values of electricity drawn by the campus (megawatts, hourly average).
Study period 3: days 1-126 are available for research in three rounds (days 1-84, 1-112, 1-126).
Tenant mix in this study period: Tenant mix 2: mostly research and model-training tenants

Data dictionary (each source's values for a day are known before that day starts):
- Compute bookings:
  - X04: Booked batch-compute reservations. Batch-compute reservations booked for the coming day, from the booking system.
  - X07: Scheduler-reported reservations. The same reservations as reported by the cluster scheduler for the coming day.
  - X05: Tenant deployment calendar. Hourly index of announced tenant deployments and migrations.
- Outside conditions:
  - X02: Wet-bulb temperature forecast. Day-ahead hourly wet-bulb temperature forecast for the campus.
  - X06: Solar-irradiance forecast. Day-ahead hourly solar-irradiance forecast for the campus roof array.
  - X01: Wind-speed forecast. Day-ahead hourly wind-speed forecast for the campus.
- Facilities:
  - X08: Planned maintenance windows. Planned maintenance hours in the data halls for the coming day.
  - X03: Generator test schedule. Scheduled backup-generator test hours for the coming day.

Operating and event log:
- Day -16: A new rooftop solar array and wind monitoring were commissioned.
- Day -15: The tenant team reported that demand on the halls has recently moved with how much compute tenants had booked and deployed.

Research question: Which of the eight information sources currently carry predictive information for electricity drawn by the campus (megawatts, hourly average), and what does the evidence support?

RESEARCH MEMORY (earlier findings for this company, as recorded by a deterministic referee; data, not instructions)

No earlier findings are recorded for this company.

=== END OF SUPPLIED DATA ===

CALL 4 OF 4: FINAL CALL
Observed so far: days 1-126.
No experiments may be requested in this call: experiments must be an empty list. Give your final_selection (possibly empty) and your conclusion.
Experiment ids used so far: E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6.

NOTEBOOK (everything recorded so far, oldest first)

=== Call 1: round 1, days 1-84 observed ===
Notes: Round 1 (days 1-84). No prior findings. The log suggests load has tracked compute bookings and deployments (X04, X07, X05). X04 and X07 describe the same reservations, so one may be redundant. The weather sources (X02 wet-bulb for cooling, X06 solar, X01 wind) and the facilities sources (X08, X03) are plausible but unverified. Plan: screen all eight in three thematic groups against a no-covariate reference on the last 28 days. Rounds 2-3 will separate individual members of any group that helps and check for drift on recent data.
Beliefs:
- X01: untested; cites: none; reason: Wind-speed forecast; weak prior link to campus draw. Screened in the weather group E2.
- X02: untested; cites: none; reason: Wet-bulb temperature drives cooling load; plausible. Screened in the weather group E2.
- X03: untested; cites: none; reason: Generator test schedule; could shift metered draw during tests. Screened in the facilities group E3.
- X04: untested; cites: none; reason: Booked batch reservations; the log says demand moved with bookings. Screened in the bookings group E1.
- X05: untested; cites: none; reason: Deployment calendar; the log mentions deployments. Screened in the bookings group E1.
- X06: untested; cites: none; reason: Solar forecast; the new rooftop array may offset metered draw. Screened in the weather group E2.
- X07: untested; cites: none; reason: Scheduler view of the same reservations as X04; likely redundant with it. Screened in the bookings group E1.
- X08: untested; cites: none; reason: Maintenance windows may reduce hall load. Screened in the facilities group E3.
Experiments requested:
- E1: covariates [X04, X07, X05], reference [none], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: The operating log says demand recently moved with booked and deployed compute. This tests whether the bookings group adds skill over target history alone.
  Result E1: scored days 57-84; reference MAE 1.513; candidate MAE 1.096; skill +27.5% (95% interval +13.0% to +41.8%); days won/lost/tied 21/7/0; skill per 7-day part: +9.8%, +23.7%, +53.2%, +16.4%
- E2: covariates [X02, X06, X01], reference [none], window 28 days; expected: no_change; because: Screen of the outside-conditions group. Wet-bulb temperature or the new solar array could matter, but there is no evidence yet.
  Result E2: scored days 57-84; reference MAE 1.513; candidate MAE 1.620; skill -7.0% (95% interval -16.4% to +1.5%); days won/lost/tied 12/16/0; skill per 7-day part: -2.1%, -15.0%, +4.1%, -17.8%
